items.heading: One Core Skill Matched
items.text: One core skill matched to a real market gap. Not whatever is trending this month, something with actual, checkable job postings or client demand behind it, chosen with the child's genuine interest in mind, not just the highest salary screenshot.

items.heading: One Multiplier Skill on Top
items.text: One multiplier skill on top. Communication, basic digital or AI-tool fluency, or business sense turns a narrow technical skill into something an employer can actually deploy, not just admire on a certificate.

items.heading: Visible Proof of Work
items.text: Visible proof of work. A small finished project, a portfolio piece, a short paid gig, or a shadowing experience, something a stranger could look at and judge, not a course-completion badge nobody checks.

items.heading: An Honest Fit Check Against
items.text: An honest fit check against family reality. Time available around school or coaching hours, money available, and whether the skill genuinely suits how this specific child likes to work, not a generic "everyone should learn coding" answer.
